review_candidates.title: Shift Engineer
review_candidates.description: BRAND INTRODUCTION At Montcalm Collection, we believe that timeless style and genuine hospitality are more than just values; they’re a way of life. Our people are the heart of our hotels: passionate individuals working together as a team, united by an unwavering commitment to providing first-class personal service. Our collection spans some of London’s most storied buildings, from elegant Georgian townhouses and an 18th-century brewery to a historic head office and a contemporary architectural landmark. Each hotel has its own unique story, and within everyone, our team create unforgettable experiences for our guests. While our walls speak of history, it’s our people, their ambition, and their creativity that shapes our future. Join us, and become part of a culture that celebrates individuality, nurtures potential, and upholds the very highest standards of the art of hospitality. WHY JOIN MONTCALM COLLECTION Competitive salary that reflects your talent, contribution, and potential. Generous holiday allowance, starting at 28 days (including bank holidays) and increasing with service—supporting your life beyond work. Paid birthday leave, so you can celebrate your special day your way. We celebrate life’s milestones with you, offering generous gifts and financial support for special occasions such as weddings and the arrival of a new baby. Comprehensive wellbeing support, including free access to our Employee Assistance Programme provided by Hospitality Action, offering confidential support, wellbeing resources, and free legal advice. Tailored wellbeing experiences, from yoga sessions and life coaching to wellbeing workshops designed to support both mind and body. Cashback healthcare plan, covering dental, optical, physiotherapy, and alternative treatments—helping you stay at your best. Preferential gym membership rates, helping you maintain your health and vitality. Continuous learning and development opportunities, from hands-on training to leadership masterclasses—empowering your career growth. Paid volunteering day, giving you the opportunity to support a charity close to your heart. Employee referral programme, rewarding you for bringing great talent into our teams. Complimentary meals on duty in our team restaurant. Exclusive room rate discounts across the Montcalm Collection. International hotel discounts through Marriott Bonvoy, giving you access to exceptional global experiences. City-wide discounts and perks, with savings across retail, entertainment, essential services, fashion, and more. Recognition programmes, including vouchers and curated rewards that celebrate excellence and individuality. Elegant annual celebrations and social events, bringing our teams together to connect and celebrate in style. Role Overview The Shift Engineer is a key member of the Maintenance team, responsible for delivering prompt, effective, and high-quality engineering support across the property. This role ensures that all hotel systems, facilities, and equipment are maintained to Montcalm’s luxury standards while complying with statutory and legal regulations. Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the Shift Engineer will work across planned and reactive maintenance tasks, contribute to energy efficiency initiatives, and provide technical expertise to support a seamless guest and colleague experience. Responsibilities Oversee day-to-day maintenance operations, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, and general building upkeep. Ensure all guest and staff maintenance requests are resolved promptly and effectively. Coordinate with Front Office and Housekeeping to resolve issues swiftly with minimal disruption. Uphold Montcalm’s luxury brand standards in all maintenance activities. Maintain mechanical, electrical, architectural, and decorative finishes to the highest standard. Develop and implement preventive maintenance programmes. Lead, supervise, and motivate the maintenance team and external contractors. Monitor and control departmental expenses, labour, and contracted services. Maintain inventory of tools, supplies, and spare parts. Conduct performance reviews and foster a positive team culture. Ensure adherence to hotel policies, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and corrective actions. Coordinate with external inspectors to ensure certifications are up to date. Maintain detailed maintenance records and reports. Implement energy efficiency initiatives and monitor usage. Actively participate in emergency and crisis response planning. Skills And Qualifications High attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure. WORKING CONDITIONS Flexible working hours including weekends, evenings, and bank holidays. Requires standing / walking for extended periods and manual handling. Eligibility Candidates must be authorised to live and work in the UK. Currently, visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Equal Opportunity Employer At Montcalm Collection, diversity and inclusion aren't just buzzwords. We genuinely value the unique perspectives everyone brings, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, or background. Our culture thrives on mutual respect, and we provide a workplace free from discrimination and prejudice. Should this role resonate with your aspirations, please apply. If not shortlisted, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with us, either now or in the future. Note: If you do not hear from us within 14 days, kindly consider your application as not shortlisted for this role. Please note that we do not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies or headhunters. Any CVs submitted for these roles without prior agreement per role in writing from our Head of Human Resources, will be considered the property of the company and will not be subject to agency fees.

review_candidates.title: Manager, Global Enterprise Batch Services
review_candidates.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Summary Job Description The Manager, Global Enterprise Batch Services, is responsible for leading a global operations team that supports enterprise batch processing, workload execution, incident response, alert triage, client delivery monitoring, and operational readiness across distributed, mainframe, and related batch platforms. This role ensures batch services are executed reliably, issues are identified and escalated quickly, and service-level risks are managed with strong operational discipline. The manager partners closely with application teams, Global Workload Orchestration, engineering, MIM, change management, and business stakeholders to maintain availability, improve resiliency, and reduce operational risk. As GenAI becomes embedded into daily operations, the manager is also expected to help shift the team from reactive batch monitoring to predictive workload intelligence by using AI-assisted investigation, automated summaries, runbook improvement, workflow automation, and data-driven recommendations to improve service outcomes. Key Responsibilities Lead Global Enterprise Batch Services operations across shift-based coverage, ensuring batch processing, workload monitoring, escalation, turnover, and service execution are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. Provide oversight for batch job failures, late executions, missed dependencies, SLA exposure, Control-M/ESP issues, file delivery concerns, and related production events that may impact client or business outcomes. Ensure timely triage, recovery coordination, ticket updates, communication, handoff, and escalation for incidents, alerts, changes, and operational requests involving GEBS-supported services. Partner with Global Workload Orchestration, application owners, engineering, MIM, database, network, vendor, Client Services, Product, Technology, and regional operations teams to resolve issues and maintain follow-the-sun service coverage. Manage operational risk across supported services, including settlement batch activity, IPDP and client file deliveries, DPS batch services, Control-M/ESP dependencies, and related application workflows. Support incident and change stewardship through clear communications, post-incident recaps, executive summaries, business impact statements, Service Impact Notification inputs, operational readiness reviews, validation criteria, rollback clarity, and batch-service risk assessment. Identify recurring failures, false positives, alert noise, manual intervention points, and operational patterns that can be improved through automation, monitoring enhancements, process redesign, dashboards, knowledge-base modernization, or client self-service capabilities. Promote responsible GenAI adoption by helping the team use approved AI tools for incident summarization, knowledge retrieval, runbook validation, operational analysis, documentation generation, SLA-risk forecasting, alert correlation, restart recommendations, and repetitive workflow automation. Maintain appropriate human oversight for high-risk decisions, client-impact assessments, production changes, critical incidents, and any AI-generated recommendation before execution. Develop and mentor team members in batch operations, incident management, Control-M/ESP fundamentals, automation thinking, GenAI fluency, operational documentation, service ownership, and cross-regional collaboration. Provide Director delegate support when required, including management communication, operational representation, escalation support, and leadership coverage during major events or business-critical changes. Leadership Expectations & Success Measures Maintain reliable batch operations with strong focus on SLA protection, timely escalation, accurate turnover, and minimal client or business impact. Demonstrate effective leadership of a global shift-based team, including prioritization, coaching, issue ownership, and cross-regional coordination. Ensure incidents, changes, alerts, and operational requests are handled in accordance with documented procedures, ITIL practices, and change/incident stewardship expectations. Improve operational effectiveness by reducing recurring incidents, unnecessary alerts, manual rework, and avoidable escalations through process improvement and automation. Expand responsible GenAI usage across the team, with measurable adoption in incident summaries, knowledge retrieval, runbook updates, operational analysis, and repetitive workflow reduction. Build predictive batch operations capability by using data, trend analysis, and AI-assisted insights to identify SLA risk, failure patterns, workload constraints, and service improvement opportunities. Communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, and leadership, especially during incidents, high-risk changes, and service-impacting events. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience Preferred Qualifications 5-8 years of relevant work experience Strong client and customer-service mindset with focus on operational reliability, accuracy, and timely communication. Ability to lead by example, remain calm under pressure, and make sound decisions during production-impacting events. Strong documentation, reporting, and written communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues into clear business language. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, automation, operational excellence, and responsible GenAI adoption. Builds team capability by coaching others, encouraging experimentation, and helping employees shift from manual execution to higher-value operational analysis and service improvement. Working Conditions Role supports a 24x7 global operations environment and may require coverage across US, Singapore, India, or other regional operating hours. May be required to work outside normal business hours to support incidents, critical batch windows, high-risk changes, client-impacting events, or major implementations. Weekend, holiday, and off-hour support may be required based on business need, production schedules, or operational escalation requirements. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $121,100.00 to $ 193,900.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. review_candidates.title: Maintenance Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose and Impact The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for executing maintenance strategies, resource management, and process controls to maintain and improve equipment reliability, asset utilization, and quality standards. This role supports safe and efficient plant operations by ensuring maintenance activities are planned and executed effectively to meet production requirements. The Maintenance Engineer works closely with the production team to prioritize, coordinate, and execute maintenance work, while driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance, equipment availability and cost efficiency. Key Accountabilities Perform and verify engineering designs for maintenance, repair, and replacement activities through sound calculations, technical analysis, and engineering judgment. Coordinate the implementation of equipment strategies for assets involved in containing, controlling, or safeguarding high-hazard processes. Ensure, establish and enable inventory is kept at proper level, i.e. 1.5% to 2% of Replacement Asset Value (RAV). Prepare and manage the annual repairs and maintenance budget, targeting approximately 3% of RAV and develop operational budgets to monitor performance against approved estimates. Execute specific equipment maintenance for each asset that involved with containing, controlling or safeguarding a high hazard process. Implement, monitor and sustain best maintenance practices to enhance operational effectiveness through continuous improvement and reliability excellence methodologies. Monitor capitalized repair and replacement projects, mitigate risks and remove barriers to ensure milestones are achieved on time and within budget. Develop and manage OPEX and CAPEX budgets while controlling maintenance and repair costs. Collaborate with the Production team and other departments to improve plant capacity, reliability and operational efficiency. Ensure the ongoing mechanical, electrical, and structural integrity of all plant equipment and facilities. Lead and execute effective maintenance planning and scheduling activities. Develop mill improvement plans and oversee the execution of mill maintenance and repair programs. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in maintenance or engineering. Demonstrates high integrity, strong analytical thinking and financial management skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment with a strong commitment to safety standards and operational excellence, working knowledge of ISO standards and quality management systems. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Strong problem solving, planning, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Preferred Qualifications: Strong knowledge of Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) principles, with expertise in process safety and construction safety management. Comprehensive understanding of palm oil mill equipment and facilities, including jetties, receiving stations, turbines, utilities, wastewater treatment systems and supporting infrastructure. In-depth knowledge of milling equipment design, installation requirements, operating efficiency ( startup and shutdown procedures, etc.) maintenance strategies and "Management of Change" related of milling. Strong understanding of palm oil milling technologies, Kernel Crushing and Biogas Plant technologies, processes and operational best practices to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable production. Know different "characteristics" of FFB deliveries to optimize/guide optimal efficiencies of actual deliveries. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
